meta.title: Singapore MRT & LRT Network
meta.description: An independently produced schematic diagram of Singapore's rail network for the Waypoint app. Not to scale, and not the official LTA/SMRT map.
sources: https://www.lta.gov.sg/ (news releases: Punggol Coast, Hume, Circle Line Stage 6)
excluded: Cross Island Line (under construction, not open)
Jurong Region Line (under construction, not open)
Mount Pleasant (TE) — built but mothballed, trains skip it
Marina South (TE) — built but mothballed, trains skip it
Bukit Brown (CC18) — reserved station, not built/opened
